title: Forest Flight
pitch: Two distinct airplanes, one forest airstrip, a short scenic flight and satisfying return landing.

authorization.basis: User requested full delegated implementation in a dedicated worktree, with no merge until personal playtest.

mustHave: Forest airfield with clear graded runway and approaches
Trainer and sport aircraft with distinct handling and animation
Takeoff, scenic flight, landing, crash recovery, pause and restart
Chase and cockpit views, audio/mute, flight HUD and graphics settings

milestones.title: Complete trainer loop
deliverables: Airfield, trainer, flight controls and rules
acceptance: Real input can take off, fly and land or recover

milestones.title: Distinct aircraft and presentation
deliverables: Sport plane, cameras, sound, polished world/HUD
acceptance: Both aircraft selectable and distinct, useful flight feedback

milestones.title: Validation and review
deliverables: Meaningful tests, browser evidence, review and handoff
acceptance: Tests/lint/build pass, both real-input loops exercised, art review bounded

playthrough: Both aircraft takeoff-flight-landing through real input
Pause/focus reset, restart, crash recovery, camera and settings

stopAfter: Committed playable game ready for user playtest. Preserve worktree; no merge or framework extraction.
